description: Relative pressure drift for surface-floating fish, pressure port fully submerged.

reference.time_origin: First valid sample of uninterrupted 10Hz sensor acquisition, not motor start.
reference.pressure_origin: First valid pressure sample of each recording; each run starts at 0 Pa drift.
reference.runtime_p0: Pressure measured at the same surface posture and port immersion at t=0.
reference.multi_sample_p0: Optional noise reduction: mean(P_i - f(t_i)) over initial surface samples.
reference.depth_origin: Depth change relative to this surface posture; port immersion is included in P0.

lookup.index_rule: t_i = start_s + i * step_s; values are relative drift, not absolute pressure.
lookup.out_of_range: Outside [0,7200] is not covered by this calibration table.

usage.clock: Use monotonic sensor acquisition elapsed time. Do not reset when motors stop if acquisition continues.
usage.restart: A pause/reset/power cycle may change drift; reestablish the acquisition conditions and surface P0.

fit.offset_removal: subtract first sample, independently per recording
fit.weighting: equal total squared-error weight per recording

bounded.note: Temporal holdout uses each run's initial pressure; not a 2h validation.

linear_tail.note: Temporal holdout uses each run's initial pressure; not a 2h validation.

notes: After approximately 3600 s the curve is extrapolated, not measured.
Saturating recovery is an empirical extrapolation assumption, not an established physical law.
Only one recording reaches 60 min; per-run drift shape differs even after zeroing.
Identical sensor, 10Hz conversion settings, start conditions and immersion are required for transfer.
Dynamic flow pressure, water temperature changes and real depth changes are not modeled.
